title: clientjoinserver
description: This mod is designed to send players instantly to connect to server as soon as they load the game and on the server-side reward them for using the mod.
body:
This mod allows you to reward players for joining your server for using a the mod which you can include in any modpack. It also automatically connects clients with the installed mod to a server instantly when they load up the game. When installed both server and client side it will recognize that the mod is installed and rewards the player.

Features of this mod:
Auto-adds and auto-connects to your server on game start
Sends the modpack name to the server for instant first-join rewards
Server runs configurable commands on first join (placeholders: {player}, {modpack})
Friendly reminders for players without the mod (with a clickable download link)
Clean logs and one-time reward tracking
Fabric 1.21.1, proxy-friendly (Velocity/TCPShield compatible)
